name: bba-sports-platform
description: BBA Sports Academy — multi-centre coaching platform (BBA Sports Private Limited)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:webapp && npm run build:functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --project bba-sports-prod
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:webapp && firebase deploy --only hosting --project bba-sports-prod
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build --workspace=@bba/functions && firebase deploy --only functions --project bba-sports-prod
